Describe the parts a subclass adds to a scale

Source: R/tree.R
scale_payload_parts.Rd

The seam a dimension package overrides so that scale_tree() can mark the properties it adds and name its own verbs. The method returns a data.frame with a part column and any of parent, kind, shape, mark, verb and note. A row whose part and parent match a part the core already lists replaces the fields it gives; any other row is added. A top-level part is a property of the object; parent names the property a part belongs to. mark is one of "fixed", "derived" or "mutable". The NestedScale default adds nothing.

Usage

scale_payload_parts(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A NestedScale.

...

Not used.

Value

A data.frame of parts, or NULL.

See also

scale_tree()

Examples

scale_payload_parts(scale_example())
#> NULL
